title: Amazwi Asecaleni Kwamanzi Azolileyo
intro: Khawucinge ngoluntu olungabizwanga ngenxa yesixeko okanye umlawuli, kodwa ngenxa yamanzi angashukumiyo apho ubomi buqokelelene khona. Zimbalwa iivesi ezikhumbula olu luntu, oluhlala ludweliswe phakathi kwabo balahla ulwalathiso. Mamela njengoko bethetha besuka emfihlakalweni.
clues: Siluluntu olubizwa ngegama leQuran, kodwa ibali lethu ligcwele imfihlakalo.
Sisoloko sikhankanywa kunye nabo bakhanyelayo, njengabantu bakwa-Ad nooThamud.
Sibizwa ngokuba singabahlobo base-Ar-Rass, iqula apho ubomi bethu babubotshelelwe khona.
Simkhanyele umthunywa owayethunyelwe kuthi ngesikhokelo esicacileyo.
Sibalwa phakathi kwabo bangazange bamkele bonke abathunywa abathunyelwe ngu-Allah.
Sijongene nosongelo oluzaliswa ngabo bonke abaphikayo phambi kwethu, intshabalalo ngenxa yokwaliwa kwethu.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
